name: Mars
summary: Global elevation from the Mars Global Surveyor laser altimeter.

grid.note: MOLA 4 pixels/degree averaged to 0.5 degree for the cursor readout

layers.name: Relief
layers.note: Hillshade with 12x vertical exaggeration over hypsometric colour

sources.name: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record (MEGDR), 4 pixels per degree
sources.producer: NASA PDS Geosciences Node (Smith et al., 2003)

capabilities.name: Global elevation
capabilities.detail: MOLA gridded elevations at about 15 km per pixel; finer features are not resolved.

capabilities.name: Three-region dose comparison
capabilities.detail: Effective dose, dose equivalent and water-phantom absorbed dose at Gale, Jezero and Olympus Mons from one published transport model (Zhang et al. 2022) and one atmosphere source (Mars Climate Database v6.2), at matched assumptions. Reproduced from published tables; not validated outside Gale.

capabilities.name: Global radiation map
capabilities.detail: Only three sites have matched atmospheric inputs here; a global map would need the full MCD and transport tables over every location.
